name: Collect rent, match bank payments to leases and chase arrears with Google Sheets, Gmail, Twilio and AI

parameters.content:
## Collect rent, match bank payments to leases and chase arrears with Google Sheets, Gmail, Twilio and AI

### How it works

1. Every hour, rent falls due from the Leases tab, prorated in the first and last month.
2. Bank lines are matched by reference, then payer name, then amount. Split, combined and returned payments are handled; anything ambiguous is asked, never guessed.
3. Lateness counts to the last day your bank tab covers, so a late export never makes a tenant late.
4. Arrears climb a four-step ladder: reminder, firm, formal letter, manager.
5. Replies are read with AI: a promised date pauses the chase, a broken one escalates, disputes and hardship go to a person.
6. Rent reviews are worked out from your index, capped, and the notice goes out in time.
7. The manager gets a daily list, owners a monthly statement, and a monthly report of arrears recovered.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Connect Google Sheets, Gmail, Twilio and OpenAI.
- [ ] Create one sheet with five tabs: Leases, Owners, Index, Bank, Log.
- [ ] Fill Set Rent Settings, and translate Set Message Texts if needed.
- [ ] Paste your bank statement into the Bank tab, or feed it from your bank.

### Customization

Grace days, the ladder, late fees and the review rules are in Set Rent Settings. A lease can override its fee, its cap and chasing.

## Start on a timer or reply

The planner runs every hour. Tenants' replies arrive by text through Twilio or by email through Gmail, and are handled as they come.

## Set your rules and texts

The only two nodes you edit. **Set Message Texts** holds every word a tenant reads: translate it once.

assignments.name: heads_up
assignments.value: Hi {first_name}, a reminder from {business}: {rent} for {unit} is due on {due_date}. Please use reference {reference}. {payment_details}

assignments.name: chase_1
assignments.value: Hi {first_name}, we have not received {balance} for {unit}, due on {oldest_due}. If you have just paid, thank you. If not, please pay with reference {reference}, or reply to tell us when you will. {payment_details}

assignments.name: chase_2
chase_3
promise_ack
assignments.value: Thank you {first_name}. Noted: {amount} by {date}. We will not send reminders before then.

assignments.name: paid_ack
assignments.value: Thank you {first_name}. We will check our account; payments can take a few days to show. You will not hear from us before {date}.

assignments.name: dispute_ack
assignments.value: Thank you {first_name}. We have passed your message to {manager_name}, who will be in touch.

assignments.name: hardship_ack
assignments.value: Thank you for telling us, {first_name}. {manager_name} will contact you to talk about a payment plan.

assignments.name: review_notice
opted_out
assignments.value: You will not receive any more automatic messages from {business} by this channel.

parameters.content:
## Load leases, owners and index

Each **Aggregate** folds a read into one item, so the next read runs once. The Index tab is the monthly CPI, pasted in.

## Load the bank and log

The bank statement as pasted, and the Log tab: the only tab this workflow writes, and only by adding rows.

## Plan the day

Rent due, payments matched, fees, the reminder ladder, reviews, the daily list and the monthly statements: all decided here.

## Write the log first

Every decision is a row before anything is sent, so a failed message is never sent twice.

## Send by text or email

Each tenant's own channel, never one they said STOP to. Formal letters, the manager and owners always get email.

## Read who replied and why

Out-of-office replies and strangers are dropped. AI reads the rest, and must quote the words it decided from.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
=You read one message from a tenant who is answering a reminder about rent. Today is {{ $now.toFormat('cccc d LLLL yyyy') }}. Decide what they are telling us.

If they promise to pay, give the date as YYYY-MM-DD, worked out from today, and the amount only if they write a figure. Quote the exact words you decided from in evidence, copied from the message. If no words in the message say it, the intent is other.

attributes.name: intent
attributes.description: One of: paid (says they have already paid), promise (will pay on a date), dispute (says the amount is wrong or withholds rent over a problem), hardship (cannot pay: lost job, illness, benefits delayed), question, stop (wants no more messages), other.

attributes.name: promised_date
attributes.description: For promise only: the date they will pay, as YYYY-MM-DD.

attributes.name: promised_amount
attributes.description: For promise only: the amount, only if they wrote a figure.

attributes.name: evidence
attributes.description: The exact words from the message that show the intent, copied, not paraphrased.

parameters.content:
## Act on the reply

A promise pauses the ladder, a dispute or hardship goes to the manager, and an approved review sends the notice.

## Report a failure of the workflow

A fourth entry point, firing only when a run errors. A silent failure looks exactly like a month when everybody paid.

parameters.subject: =Rent workflow failed: {{ $json.execution.id }}
